note: The RSF1030 (ColE1-family) origin of replication: the 563 bp region from the RNA II promoter -35 to the RNA-to-DNA transition, with the RNA I / RNA II antisense pair that sets copy number; compatible with ColE1/pMB1 and p15A origins.

provenance.closest_deposit: RSF1030 origin; bases J01784 121-683 (Som & Tomizawa 1982), reverse complement, with 5 G/C swaps against J01784 (bases 232, 236, 245, 250, 307), all kept in the new span. Re-delimited (2026-11) from a 750 bp record (J01784 104-853): the old part also carried the 170 bp past the RNA-to-DNA transition (J01784 684-853), the RSF1030 counterpart of the pBR322 2351-2533 flank (primosome assembly site region) that the ColE1 part dropped, and 17 bp upstream of the RNA II -35.

functional_claims.label: Spans RSF1030 J01784 121-683: from the RNA II promoter -35 to the RNA-to-DNA transition. End: replication starts in a stretch identical to the ColE1 origin (Som & Tomizawa 1982), so the part ends at the ColE1 part's end by alignment (J01784 683 = pBR322 2534); the primer is about 530 nt and J01784 maps its precursor's 5' end at 155, which places the transition near 684. Start: the RNA II -35 is not mapped; the part starts at TTGACT (J01784 121-126), the hexamer 34 bp upstream of the mapped RNA II 5' end, the same distance as ColE1's -35 (alignment and promoter geometry only).

source.quote: Replication of pST19 starts at one of three consecutive nucleotides (dA, dA or dC) located at a unique position in the region where the nucleotide sequence is identical to that of the ColE1 origin.
